title: Gimme Shelter Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Gimme Shelter Lockoff is a one bedroom lockoff in a prime location in Seaside, Florida. This completely renovated one bedroom has designer furnishings throughout and a modern beach vibe complete with a king primary! A perfect escape for two to Seaside, Fl.
description_expanded: Description12 BUTLER STREET1 KINGWelcome to Gimme Shelter Lockoff in Seaside, FloridaTucked away along a peaceful, shaded footpath in the heart of Seaside, Gimme Shelter is a fully renovated lockoff cottage named after the owner’s favorite tune. Designed as a romantic coastal retreat, this charming beach home is available exclusively during the winter season, offering the perfect off-season escape for two in Seaside, Florida.Charming Arrival & Outdoor LivingGuests arrive via a tranquil, tree-lined walkway that instantly sets the tone for relaxation. At the front of the cottage, an open-air porch with seating for two invites you to enjoy morning coffee or an evening cocktail surrounded by lush greenery. Upstairs, a covered balcony porch features outdoor dining for four and serene treetop views, creating an ideal setting for unwinding after a day at the beach.Primary King Suite & Spa-Inspired BathThe first level of the home is dedicated to comfort and privacy, featuring a king primary bedroom with a mounted flat-screen TV and closet space. The newly renovated ensuite bathroom offers a spa-like experience with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, rain shower head, and handheld wand, perfect for rinsing off after sandy beach days.Open-Concept Living & Modern KitchenUpstairs, the second floor opens into a bright, contemporary living space designed for lounging and entertaining. Enjoy comfortable seating, a flat-screen Apple TV, and a welcoming dining area with seating for four. The fully equipped open kitchen makes it easy to prepare meals at home, whether it’s a casual breakfast or a cozy dinner in.Thoughtful Amenities for a Relaxing StayGimme Shelter is outfitted with everything you need for a seamless Seaside vacation, including Sonos speakers, Apple TV, a washer and dryer, an outdoor shower, and a pole-mounted grill for easy outdoor cooking. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to enhance your stay and provide a true coastal escape.Your Off-Season Seaside EscapePerfect for couples seeking peace, comfort, and coastal charm, Gimme Shelter Lockoff offers a serene alternative to the busy summer season. If you’re looking to slow down, reconnect, and enjoy the beauty of Seaside, Florida in winter, this inviting cottage is your ideal getaway.* 2-night minimum during Winter, available only in the off-season. Must be 25 to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES900 square feetSeaside Private Beach at West Ruskin PavilionSeaside is home to the largest private residential beach on 30A176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessWasher & DryerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
